name: tracker-hub-sync
goal: Prove the five signed Tracker 122e190 hub routes, journal cursor recovery and long-poll lifecycle with synthetic in-process stores.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Match all five authenticated 122e190 route responses and the peer observation API. Prove cursor rewind, long-poll notification and cancellation, push retry, malformed request handling and telemetry through synthetic stores and no listener.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Added an internal handler with the PR #140 verifier, injected stores, raw target and body binding, bounded inputs, release-compatible responses, and cancellable journal polling without a listener.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: On harbor-mbp-2 with one worker, all 13 Tracker handler cases and three signing cases passed at 70a65abbbb. An in-process comparison matched 12 signatures and byte-for-byte responses from release 122e190. The final revision gets the same route checks.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
